description: This file provides a singleton-based interface for managing MongoDB connections, including environment-based configuration, index setup, and lazy initialization. It encapsulates connection logic, index creation for the 'devices' collection, and exposes functions to retrieve the client, database, and collection objects.

methods.name: _build_mongo_client
methods.description: Constructs a MongoClient instance based on environment variables, including optional TLS and connection timeout settings.

methods.name: _ensure_indexes
methods.description: Creates necessary indexes on the 'devices' collection, including a unique index on 'ip_address' and non-unique indexes on 'type' and 'status'.

methods.name: get_client
methods.description: Returns a singleton MongoClient instance, initializing it if necessary, with lazy loading and environment-based configuration.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Returns the default Database instance, initializing the client if needed.

methods.name: get_collection
methods.description: Returns a collection object from the default database by name.
